$comment: Schema for each record in results/normalized/results.json. Records are GENERATED by scripts/normalize.py from results/raw/*.json; do not edit by hand.
status: enum: confirmed_detection | telemetry_observed | partial | not_tested | confirmed_miss
latency_ms: number|null (only when a real measurement exists)
evidence_events: string|null (repo-relative path to raw event stream)
interpretation: string (explicit reasoning for the assigned status)
